traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for Story 025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION are fully implemented and verified: - CatchClause annotations are detected both before the catch keyword and inside the catch block body. - When both positions exist, before-catch annotations take precedence. - Fallback behavior correctly uses getCommentsInside when available and a line-based scan inside the block when necessary. - Auto-fix for missing annotations on CatchClause inserts comments inside the catch body in a formatter-stable position. - Integration tests confirm that Prettier-formatted code passes traceability checks without manual intervention. - Rule tests demonstrate that other branches (if/switch/loops/try/finally/else-if) behave as before, indicating no regressions. - User-facing API documentation explicitly describes the dual catch positions, precedence, and Prettier-aware auto-fix behavior. Given the passing test suite and aligned documentation, this story is assessed as PASSED.
